# Stable copy catalog before queued and cardless births

Sample23 Ring3's first native EndTurn exposes a capture defect after the
triple-Juice Starstruck guards are calibrated. The release243 catalog contains
12 birth definitions at deployment but13 after Arkion is born: only the
Boss_Level3_Arkion_SiphonRage entry is added. Full battle trace
175737-e79058a6 retains the native first-turn difference; the actual default
run175819-19d45973 independently reports the same catalog-length mismatch.

Release244 includes captured queued outer/true-final bosses before their births
and walks known card and character-trigger SpawnFallbackUnit definitions
transitively. This also includes the original cardless Funguy before the first
Harvest. Existing character templates, gear/cards/abilities, callback handling,
complete state keys and runtime successor validation are retained.

Native source180239-3792851d and independently repaired capture180456-7db4168b
pass all four inputs. The historical comparison removes only the exact added
Arkion/Funguy definitions after validating their full payloads against the new
capture; every existing definition, physical successor, forecast and RNG remains
identical. New runtime keys retain all14 definitions. Four immutable EndTurn
branches pass. The Starstruck Full Moon/cumulative curse components also pass
their independent30/36-input native pairs with full state/forecast/RNG checks.

The actual default Ring3 run180351-94fd69bb physically wins but exposes a
separate cross-floor preview-Funguy destruction timing difference in room/train
components. Its full EndTurn decisions match, but it is not accepted as a
campaign victory until that component difference is fixed and replayed.
